controls.title: All users must authenticate using approved multi-factor credentials before accessing any system

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: All users must authenticate using approved multi-factor credentials before accessing any system

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
This section defines access control requirements for organizational systems.
All users must authenticate using approved multi-factor credentials before accessing any system
Access permissions must follow the principle of least privilege for all user roles
User accounts must be reviewed quarterly and inactive accounts disabled after 90 days
All authentication events must be logged and retained for a minimum of one year
